evals.prompt: Write the skeleton Solution Design for checkout-foundation — end-to-end slice, files shipped, out of scope for this epic.
evals.expected_output: specs/checkout-foundation/design.md, 2–4 pages, cites solution.md, §4 lists deferred work, no task Gherkin.

Cites solution.md by section rather than copying full architecture
No Feature:/Scenario: blocks (those belong in TASKS.local.md)

assertions: Does not create a second design document alongside the existing one

evals.prompt: Write a Solution Design for JIRA-123. It is a story under checkout-foundation.

assertions: Writes a story-level design.md beside (not inside) the epic folder
